whatThisIs: Look up the genotype at one position, or one ID, in your own VCF without uploading it. Large and bgzipped files are read a piece at a time, with progress and a Stop button.
whenToUse: Use this when a report or a paper names a variant and you want to see what your VCF says at that position: the genotype as written, its zygosity, depth, quality and allele balance.
inputs: A .vcf, .vcf.gz or .vcf.bgz file; a chromosome and position (with REF and ALT if you know them) or an ID from the ID column; a sample name if the file has more than one. The file stays in the browser tab.
output: The matching record's REF, ALT, QUAL and FILTER, and the sample's GT as written, phase, zygosity, DP, GQ and allele balance, with the assembly the file states. A position the file does not list reads "not in this file", never "reference".

rows: REF G, ALT A, QUAL 29, FILTER PASS
